value.title: SharedBlackboard module (WAL facts.db wrapper)
value.description: Build the bounded inter-agent exchange wrapper over one shared facts.db opened with WAL + busy_timeout — the risk-first foundation (WAL concurrency is the highest unknown). New file src/fleet/shared-blackboard.ts exports: const BLACKBOARD_MAX_ROUNDS = 3; type BlackboardFinding = { childFolder: string; round: number; payload: string; confidence?: number }; class SharedBlackboard with a static/factory open(opts:{dbPath,namespace,busyTimeoutMs?,maxRounds}) that opens the shared db with PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL and PRAGMA busy_timeout, creating file+table if absent; publish(finding, now): writes a FactRecord via FactStore.insertFact (scope=namespace, subject=childFolder, predicate='finding', value=payload, confidence) and THROWS when finding.round > min(maxRounds, BLACKBOARD_MAX_ROUNDS); readSiblings(selfFolder): FactRecord[] = getActiveFacts(namespace, undefined, 'finding') filtered to subject !== selfFolder; readAll(): all active 'finding' facts in the namespace; close(). The WAL pragma must be enabled WITHOUT changing the behavior of existing FactStore callers — preferred mechanism: add an OPTIONAL second constructor arg to FactStore (e.g. `new FactStore(dbPath, { journalModeWal?: boolean; busyTimeoutMs?: number })`) that defaults to OFF (existing callers byte-identical), and SharedBlackboard constructs FactStore with { journalModeWal: true, busyTimeoutMs }. No engine/coordinator/CLI wiring this sprint.

successCriteria.description: The project builds with zero TypeScript errors (npm run build) and zero typecheck errors (npm run typecheck).
The full test suite passes with zero new failures (npm run test); only the 6 known cockpit-integration MCP failures may fail.
SharedBlackboard.open(dbPath) opens the db in WAL mode (a test reads `PRAGMA journal_mode` and asserts 'wal') and creates the facts file+table if absent.

publish(finding, now) writes a FactRecord with scope=namespace, subject=childFolder, predicate='finding', value=payload; and THROWS when finding.round exceeds min(maxRounds, BLACKBOARD_MAX_ROUNDS=3). A test asserts both the written record and the round-cap throw.

readSiblings(selfFolder) returns active 'finding' facts in the namespace excluding subject===selfFolder; readAll() returns all; both return [] when empty (no throw). A test with 2 subjects asserts each sees only the other's findings via readSiblings and both via readAll.

Concurrent writers do not deadlock: a test issues N (>=5) concurrent publish() calls to one shared db (e.g. Promise.all) and asserts all N findings are present in readAll(). WAL + busy_timeout are enabled.

Existing FactStore callers are unaffected: constructing FactStore WITHOUT the WAL option behaves exactly as before (default journal mode); the existing FactStore tests and the medical FactStore usage pass unchanged. A test asserts a default FactStore's journal_mode is the prior default (not forced to wal).

lint passes (npm run lint, zero errors); SharedBlackboard adds no network/SDK import (depends only on FactStore/better-sqlite3 via FactStore); change confined to shared-blackboard.ts (new), facts.ts (optional opts param), + tests.

nonGoals: Do NOT wire SharedBlackboard into the coordinator, runFleet, or any CLI (Sprints 2-4).
Do NOT add config.fleet, manifest.blackboard, or the `agent-bober blackboard` command (Sprint 2).
Do NOT change FactStore's DEFAULT behavior — the WAL option must be opt-in and default off.
Do NOT implement the rounds loop or synthesis (Sprints 3-4).
Do NOT add an LLM/network dependency.
stopConditions: SharedBlackboard opens WAL, publish/readSiblings/readAll work, the round cap throws, concurrent writers succeed, existing FactStore callers are byte-identical, and build/typecheck/test/lint are green
value.definitionOfDone: src/fleet/shared-blackboard.ts exports BLACKBOARD_MAX_ROUNDS, BlackboardFinding, and SharedBlackboard (open with WAL+busy_timeout, publish with round cap, readSiblings, readAll, close). FactStore gains an optional opts param enabling WAL+busy_timeout (default off). Collocated tests cover WAL-mode, publish+round-cap, readSiblings/readAll, concurrency, and the unchanged default-FactStore path. Build/typecheck/test/lint green.
assumptions: FactStore.insertFact(input: FactInput) (facts.ts:164) is the write primitive and getActiveFacts(scope, subject?, predicate?) (facts.ts:213) the read; FactInput = {scope, subject, predicate, value(min1), confidence?(default 1)} (facts.ts:23-27).

FactStore currently opens `new Database(dbPath)` with no WAL (facts.ts:139-140); adding an optional opts param that, when set, runs db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL') + db.pragma('busy_timeout = ...') is the minimal way to give the blackboard WAL without affecting default callers.

better-sqlite3 is synchronous; 'concurrent' publish in a single process is interleaved async over one or more connections — the test exercises the WAL+busy_timeout path (multiple connections if needed to truly contend).
Findings live in the existing facts schema/table; no migration is needed — the shared db is just a facts.db opened in WAL mode.
value.generatorNotes:
Read FIRST: src/state/facts.ts in FULL — the constructor (:139-157, where Database is opened and the table created), insertFact (:164), getActiveFacts (:213), FactInput/FactRecord (:23-46), factsDbPath/memoryDir (:74-90). Decide the WAL mechanism: the cleanest is an optional 2nd constructor arg `constructor(dbPath: string, opts?: { journalModeWal?: boolean; busyTimeoutMs?: number })` — when opts.journalModeWal, call this.db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL'); when opts.busyTimeoutMs, this.db.pragma(`busy_timeout = ${opts.busyTimeoutMs}`). Default (no opts) leaves the existing behavior byte-identical. Confirm existing callers (medical, memory) pass only dbPath.

New src/fleet/shared-blackboard.ts: export const BLACKBOARD_MAX_ROUNDS = 3; export interface BlackboardFinding { childFolder: string; round: number; payload: string; confidence?: number }. export class SharedBlackboard { private store: FactStore; private namespace: string; private maxRounds: number; constructor/open({dbPath, namespace, busyTimeoutMs = 5000, maxRounds}) { ensureDir(dirname(dbPath)); this.store = new FactStore(dbPath, { journalModeWal: true, busyTimeoutMs }); this.maxRounds = Math.min(maxRounds ?? BLACKBOARD_MAX_ROUNDS, BLACKBOARD_MAX_ROUNDS); } publish(finding, now) { if (finding.round > this.maxRounds) throw new Error(`blackboard round ${finding.round} exceeds cap ${this.maxRounds}`); return this.store.insertFact({ scope: this.namespace, subject: finding.childFolder, predicate: 'finding', value: finding.payload, confidence: finding.confidence ?? 1 }); } readSiblings(selfFolder) { return this.store.getActiveFacts(this.namespace, undefined, 'finding').filter(f => f.subject !== selfFolder); } readAll() { return this.store.getActiveFacts(this.namespace, undefined, 'finding'); } close() { this.store.close(); } }.

Tests (shared-blackboard.test.ts + facts.test.ts additions): use a tmp dir db path. Assert journal_mode is 'wal' after open (read via a raw better-sqlite3 or expose a tiny test seam). publish + round-cap throw. readSiblings/readAll with 2 subjects. Concurrency: Promise.all of N publish() (use distinct subjects/values so ids differ) then assert readAll().length===N. Default-FactStore unchanged: `new FactStore(tmp)` then assert its journal_mode is NOT 'wal' (the prior default), and the existing facts tests still pass. Follow ESM .js imports, import type, unicode section headers, no synchronous fs (use ensureDir).

Build/typecheck/lint clean; grep shared-blackboard.ts for network/SDK imports (none).

value.title: config.fleet section + manifest.blackboard + path injection + `agent-bober blackboard` CLI
value.description: Add the additive config/manifest surface and the explicit child seam. (1) src/config/schema.ts: add an OPTIONAL `fleet` section to BoberConfigSchema = { blackboardDbPath: z.string(); blackboardNamespace: z.string(); blackboardSubject: z.string(); maxRounds: z.number().int().min(1).max(3) } wrapped .optional() — needed because BoberConfigSchema strips unknown keys (schema.ts:405), so this is the child-visible channel. (2) src/fleet/manifest.ts: add optional blackboard { namespace: z.string().min(1); maxRounds: z.number().int().min(1).max(3).default(3) } to FleetManifestSchema. (3) src/fleet/index.ts (or a small helper): resolveBlackboardPath(manifest) returns join(resolve(rootDir),'.bober','memory',namespace,'facts.db') when manifest.blackboard is set, else undefined. (4) src/fleet/scaffolder.ts: when a blackboard is configured for the run, write the fleet section into each child's bober.config.json with blackboardDbPath=<the absolute shared path>, blackboardNamespace=namespace, blackboardSubject=child.folder, maxRounds; when not configured, write NO fleet section (byte-identical). (5) New `agent-bober blackboard` CLI command (registerBlackboardCommand, mirroring registerFleetCommand at cli/index.ts:321) with subcommands: `publish <value>` (loads cwd bober.config.json, opens SharedBlackboard at config.fleet.blackboardDbPath, publishes a finding with subject=config.fleet.blackboardSubject, round defaults to 1 or --round N) and `read [--all]` (prints siblings' findings, or all with --all). Both error clearly (printed message, exit 1, never throw) when no fleet section is present. The CLI reads the absolute path from config ONLY — never re-derives from cwd.

successCriteria.description: Build + typecheck pass with zero errors.
Full suite passes; only the 6 known cockpit-integration MCP failures may fail; existing config/manifest/scaffolder tests pass unchanged.

BoberConfigSchema parses a config WITH a fleet section {blackboardDbPath,blackboardNamespace,blackboardSubject,maxRounds} and WITHOUT one (absent); a config with no fleet section parses identically to today (the field is optional and absent from output).
FleetManifestSchema parses a manifest with blackboard {namespace,maxRounds} and without; maxRounds>3 is a ZodError; a no-blackboard manifest parses identically to today.

resolveBlackboardPath returns the absolute join(resolve(rootDir),'.bober','memory',namespace,'facts.db') when blackboard set, else undefined; and the scaffolder writes the fleet section (with blackboardSubject=child.folder + the absolute path) into each child bober.config.json when configured, and omits it (byte-identical child config) when not.

`agent-bober blackboard publish <value>` run in a cwd whose bober.config.json has a fleet section opens SharedBlackboard at config.fleet.blackboardDbPath and writes a finding with subject=blackboardSubject; with no fleet section it prints a clear message and exits 1 (no throw).

`agent-bober blackboard read [--all]` prints sibling findings (or all with --all) and exits 0 with an empty result when none; a two-cwd test (two configs pointing at ONE shared blackboardDbPath) confirms each cwd sees the other's published finding (path comes from config, not cwd).

lint passes; the change is additive (config schema, manifest schema, scaffolder, a resolve helper, the new CLI command + registration) and the no-blackboard fleet path is byte-identical (scaffolder writes no fleet section).

nonGoals: Do NOT implement the coordinator rounds loop (Sprint 3) — this sprint only injects config + provides the CLI seam.
Do NOT auto-wire the blackboard into `agent-bober run` — participation is via the explicit `agent-bober blackboard` CLI only.
Do NOT change the no-blackboard scaffolder output (omit the fleet section entirely).
Do NOT re-derive the db path from cwd in the CLI — read it from config.fleet only.
stopConditions: config.fleet + manifest.blackboard parse additively, resolveBlackboardPath + scaffolder inject the absolute path per child, the `agent-bober blackboard` publish/read CLI works across two cwds via one shared path, and the no-blackboard path is byte-identical

value.title: SynthesisStep + fleet-synthesis.json artifact
value.description: After the rounds complete, assemble a PURE data bundle of the final-round child results plus all blackboard findings and write it to a separate <rootDir>/.bober/fleet-synthesis.json for the head to synthesize. New file src/fleet/synthesis.ts exports: type SynthesisBundle = { rounds: number; childResults: <the final executions/outcomes shape used by the reporter>; findings: FactRecord[] }; function collect(blackboard: SharedBlackboard | null, childResults, rounds): SynthesisBundle — findings = blackboard ? blackboard.readAll() : []; returns the bundle; performs NO LLM call and no network. Wire into runFleet: when a blackboard was used, after the rounds + the existing fleet-report.json write, call collect(...) and atomically write fleet-synthesis.json (tmp+rename, mirroring the report writer); when no blackboard, write NOTHING (byte-identical). The existing fleet-report.json remains unchanged in shape and is always written.

successCriteria.description: Build + typecheck pass with zero errors.
Full suite passes; only the 6 known cockpit-integration MCP failures may fail; existing fleet report/index tests pass unchanged.

SynthesisStep.collect(blackboard, childResults, rounds) returns { rounds, childResults, findings } where findings===blackboard.readAll(); when blackboard is null it returns findings:[] and the caller writes NO file. A test asserts both branches.

On a blackboard-enabled run, <rootDir>/.bober/fleet-synthesis.json is written containing the final-round childResults + all findings + the round count; the existing fleet-report.json is also written and unchanged in shape. A test runs a blackboard fleet and asserts both files exist with the expected content.
SynthesisStep performs NO LLM/network call — a test asserts no provider/client is constructed and no network import exists in synthesis.ts.

When no blackboard is configured, NO fleet-synthesis.json is written and the run output is byte-identical to Phase A (the existing fleet tests pass unchanged; a test asserts the file is absent on a no-blackboard run).
lint passes; the synthesis write is additive + gated on a blackboard being used; the fleet-report.json shape/behavior is unchanged.

nonGoals: Do NOT perform any LLM synthesis — collect is pure data; the head/dynamic-workflow synthesizes.
Do NOT change the fleet-report.json shape or stop writing it.
Do NOT write fleet-synthesis.json on a no-blackboard run.
Do NOT change the rounds loop (Sprint 3) or the blackboard module (Sprint 1).
stopConditions: fleet-synthesis.json is written (final childResults + all findings + rounds) only on a blackboard run, collect is pure (no LLM), the report is unchanged, the no-blackboard path is byte-identical, and build/typecheck/test/lint are green
